'''Galactic Alliance Infantry Troopers''' were the standard [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Army]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Sith–Imperial War]] and [[Second Imperial Civil War]] over a [[137 ABY|hundred and thirty-seven]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. They wore [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] [[Armor/Legends|body armor]] and [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]], and were deployed alongside [[Galactic Alliance Infantry Scout|infantry scouts]].<ref name="Legacy Campaign" />
